name: Customer search, screening filters and pagination preserve the registry
covers: production or TEST Google Sheets source
customer ID hidden in registry profile and edit form
saved-contact status and stable uncontacted-first registry priority
business type multi-checkbox filtering and financial year net profit screening sorts
company and phone headers are not sortable
description: Verifies the primary customer workflow can find records, recover from no results and page through the registry without writes.
steps: Sign in using the authorized Google account and wait for data to load. Do not add, edit or delete records. In the registry, confirm companies without linked contact history appear before companies with history across the full list and all pages. Existing linked history shows ได้รับการติดต่อแล้ว beneath the company name, regardless of the recorded outcome; companies without history show ยังไม่ได้ติดต่อ. Same-name companies use their exact customer relationship, and orphan records do not mark another company.

In ทะเบียนลูกค้า, search for UX-NO-MATCH-7429 and confirm the no-results message. Click ล้างตัวกรอง and confirm loaded records are restored. Confirm the registry includes a ประเภทธุรกิจ column after บริษัท. Each row shows its saved business type, with ยังไม่ระบุ for an empty value; a recognized selection from the renamed business type field is used when the category is empty, and old shop names never appear as business types. Existing financial/screening sorts remain unchanged.

Confirm บริษัท and เบอร์โทรศัพท์ headers have no sorting buttons. Use ปีงบ and กำไรสุทธิ under งบปีล่าสุด and the เกณฑ์ก่อนติดต่อ header to toggle ascending/descending; verify direction arrows and page-one reset. Missing or duplicate-year profits remain last. Click คืนลำดับเดิม. Confirm ประเภทธุรกิจ has no arrow sorting button. Open its checkbox field above the registry, select one type then a second type, and confirm only matching companies from either selected type are displayed. Select ยังไม่ระบุ to include missing types. Combine with search and screening filters; verify page-one reset, filtered summary totals and CSV export. Use แสดงทั้งหมด, then ล้างตัวกรอง, and confirm all matching records return without changing saved data. Financial and screening sorting applies within the uncontacted/contacted groups, with uncontacted companies first even after คืนลำดับเดิม. Filter and CSV use the same complete prioritized list.
Select ข้อมูลไม่พอ and confirm the matching dropdown and highlighted filter agree. Click ทั้งหมด to return to all screening states.
Change ต่อหน้า to 50. If there are more than 50 matches, use หน้าถัดไป then หน้าก่อนหน้า and confirm different records and correct row ranges. Otherwise confirm หน้าถัดไป is disabled.

If a customer exists, open the company name and confirm no customer ID is displayed. Expand financial history and close the profile. Open แก้ไขทะเบียน and confirm there is no customer ID input and exactly one ประเภทธุรกิจ dropdown; the duplicate text field and its suggestions are absent. The dropdown retains all existing choices including the seven added types and the saved value (using a recognized legacy selection only when the canonical value is empty). Change its selection and verify only one visible business type control changes; other controls and data remain unchanged. Confirm all visible fields retain their decorative leading icons and required markers, then cancel without saving.
expected: Search and filter reset restore the full registry, pagination shows the correct range without losing records, and company details retain the selected customer context. No data is changed. The profile and registry edit form omit the customer ID while existing financial and contact relationships still work. Uncontacted companies precede contacted companies across the complete filtered set; header sorting applies within each group before pagination and export, uses numeric financial values, preserves source records and can restore the original order.

name: Sidebar navigation preserves case, task and document workflows
covers: contact search retains full company history
existing contact edit and add context
free-text channel and outcome in new contact form
Call Verify and synthetic examples absent from new form
POST /api/records visible failure and retained note
POST and PUT accept custom channel and outcome text
description: Verifies the new navigation and compact overview retain the existing read-only loan workflow.
steps: Sign in using the authorized account and open ภาพรวมลูกค้าและวงเงิน, then collapse it.
Open เคสสินเชื่อ and verify ภาพรวมเคสสินเชื่อ and the read-only notice.
If a case has linked tasks, open the case then one linked task and return to the case. Verify the case ID remains the same.
Open รายการเอกสาร and confirm the checklist or its existing empty state is usable.

Open ประวัติการติดต่อ. Confirm each linked company appears once and จำนวนครั้งที่ติดต่อ is a button. If records exist, click one company's count, verify only that company's complete contact history appears with dates, channels, outcomes and facts, and close it. Search for a note in one company's history and confirm its total count and full timeline remain available. Verify บันทึกการติดต่อ remains available without saving.

Open บันทึกการติดต่อ, select a company by name only, and confirm no customer ID is displayed in its label or options. Confirm ช่องทาง and ผลการติดต่อ are editable text inputs. Leave case/date/note fields as before. Enter LINE ส่วนตัว as the channel, ขอให้ส่งข้อความอีกครั้ง as the result, and a multiline note. Submit to the injected failing POST; confirm the same inputs and note remain and then cancel without changing saved history.
expected: Each menu displays the corresponding content and active state. Case/task IDs stay consistent, documents remain accessible, and the overview can be collapsed without blocking the workflow. Contacts are grouped by company with the full recorded count, and the count opens that company's complete history without mixing other companies or deleting records. The form shows only company names, accepts arbitrary nonblank channel and result text, retains all inputs and the optional note on a failed request, and leaves other fields and historic Call Verify or legacy contact values unchanged. A failed contact save must not change a company's registry contact status or position; after a confirmed new contact is saved, that company is marked ได้รับการติดต่อแล้ว and remaining uncontacted companies fill the earlier rows without deleting any company or history.

name: Mobile follow-up filters reset and customer cards stay readable
covers: mobile company-name and free-text contact fields
description: Verifies meaningful mobile navigation, filtering and read-only review remain usable at 375px.
steps: Sign in using the authorized account and navigate with the horizontally scrollable main menu.
Open งานติดตาม. Enter UX-NO-MATCH-7429 in ค้นหางาน and select the do-not-contact filter. Click ล้างตัวกรองทั้งหมด.
Confirm search is empty, the do-not-contact checkbox is unchecked and all available tasks return.
Inspect a task detail if available and return. Do not perform contact, completion or calendar actions.

Open ทะเบียนลูกค้า, inspect a customer card if available and use its company-name button to open and close the profile. Confirm content stays inside the page width. Confirm the company profile does not display a customer ID. Confirm the company card includes ประเภทธุรกิจ with the same saved value as the desktop table and wraps long values. Confirm mobile cards show the contact-history status below the company name and uncontacted companies appear first. Open แก้ไขทะเบียน and confirm its label icons stay beside wrapped text and inputs remain usable on mobile; cancel without saving.

In ทะเบียนลูกค้า on mobile, confirm เรียงลูกค้าตาม offers only ลำดับเดิม, ปีงบล่าสุด, กำไรสุทธิของงบปีล่าสุด and เกณฑ์ก่อนติดต่อ. Choose ปีงบล่าสุด, toggle direction and click คืนลำดับเดิม. Expand the ประเภทธุรกิจ checkbox field, select two types, confirm matching mobile customer cards, then use แสดงทั้งหมด. The business-type sort option is absent.
Open ประวัติการติดต่อ on mobile. If a company has history, click its count, inspect the timeline, expand ดูข้อมูลเพิ่มเติม, close the dialog and confirm the grouped company list is restored.
On mobile, open บันทึกการติดต่อ, confirm company options display names only, enter custom ช่องทาง and ผลการติดต่อ text, confirm case/date/optional note remain unchanged, and cancel without saving.
expected: Mobile menus, filter reset and details work without clipped primary controls; existing date-verification and contact warnings remain visible and no record is modified.

name: Source failure stays visible and does not enable verified task totals
description: Verifies failed source loading remains explicit in the revised layout and does not replace real data with demo records.
steps: Sign in using the authorized account and wait for the injected source failure.
Confirm a source-error message is visible in the workspace.
Open งานติดตาม and confirm a source error is shown instead of operational current totals.
Return to ทะเบียนลูกค้า and confirm a visible retry or refresh control is available. Do not write any records.
expected: Source failure remains visible, dates stay unverified, and no Sandbox records or current task totals replace the failed response.

name: Signed-out users cannot enter the protected workspace
description: Verifies the redesigned workspace still requires the existing authorized sign-in.
steps: Sign in using the authorized account, then click ออกจากระบบ.
Confirm the Google sign-in screen is shown and the customer registry, main workspace navigation and record controls are not rendered.
Reload the page and confirm the sign-in screen remains and no customer records are visible.
expected: Signed-out users see only the sign-in screen and no protected customer, case, contact, task or document data.
